items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: But Sandy became the Universal Studios contractor for years. And she was a pain in the ass. She didn’t know nothing. So I got calls from her

ctx.x: A flugelhorn, not necessarily, or a piccolo trumpet, or anything they’re called doubles as you know, if the contractor calls you and says, “Bring a flugelhorn, they have to pay you for it whether you play it or not.” Okay? So if the call is out for the doubles, you know, when I was working at Universal there was a lady there by the name of Sandy DeCrescent who was not a musician at all, she was the secretary to the guy that was the contractor and he committed suicide. And so the union people, mostly the string…
all that and you think like should I put flute and clarinet on there and make her pay for this you know? And I was like no, I’m not going to do it.
